jobs.tierReason: security review of code that sends job text to another machine over ssh and handles secrets
jobs.prompt: Security review. tools/cli-host.mjs runs the Hermes or Qwen CLI on another machine over ssh and sends the job message on stdin. The diff coordination/review/cli-host.diff wires it into execute() and doctor in tools/swarm.mjs and relaxes parsing in tools/cli-adapters.mjs. Check, with evidence from the files: (1) can any local secret (API keys, .env, ssh keys, process.env values) reach the remote machine or its command line; (2) command injection through the model name, job fields, config values or message (quoting in shellQuote/sshInvocation); (3) whether the ssh options are safe (BatchMode, host key checking, SendEnv, agent forwarding, ConnectionAttempts); (4) whether a bad config or a hostile remote can cancel other jobs or hang the run; (5) whether the parser relaxation for the exact line 'Warning: Unknown toolsets: none' opens any hole. Finish with one JSON line: {"status":"complete","summary":"...","findings":[{"file":"...","line":0,"severity":"high|medium|low","issue":"...","fix":"..."}]}.
